text:
Riley Morgan: Hey team — quick plan note: I'm aiming to start parental leave Jan 22 for ~10 weeks. Two asks: 1) Is there a nanny-share / backup marketplace voucher we can use for the first 6 weeks instead of reimbursements? 2) I want a phased-return (4 weeks at 60% then full) — how do we document that for payroll/benefits and performance cycle alignment?

people-ops-bot: Hi Riley! See parental resources: https://intranet.redwood/people/parental-benefits. We have Backup Care reimbursements and occasional partner-marketplace vouchers. For phased-return, fill the parental intake form and choose "phased return"; that triggers Benefits + People Ops review.

Samir Nadeem: @Riley we recently piloted a marketplace voucher program for nanny-shares with vetted partners. Voucher covers up to $800/mo for shared care during the first 3 months; you still upload receipts but the voucher reduces out-of-pocket. I'll DM partner details and eligibility checklist.

Elena Gomez: For the phased return: manager needs to approve the reduced FTE schedule. People Ops then sets payroll deductions and benefits pro-rata. Please add expected weekly hours in the intake form. For performance cycle: your manager can pause or shift mid-cycle reviews. If you want reviews deferred until full return, note that in intake and tag your manager.

Riley Morgan: Great — thanks. On performance: I have a mid-cycle calibration in week 5 of my leave. Would pausing reviews affect calibration for promotion track?

Manager - Carla: @Riley we can defer your calibration participation and include a note in the calibration packet. HR prefers you opt to defer rather than have a partial review during leave; we'll capture context for compensation committees. I'll coordinate with People Ops.

Benefits Team: Quick subsidy/process notes: vouchers require intake + partner enrollment. Reimbursements: receipts uploaded within 60 days. Advances: Finance will consider one-time advances for urgent needs; request in intake and tag Payroll Ops.

Payroll Ops: To set a phased-return schedule we need: approved manager sign-off, signed phased-return agreement (we provide template), and expected pay split per pay period. Changes processed before the next payroll cut if submitted 7 business days in advance.

Riley Morgan: Noted. I'll attach proposed weekly schedule and sign the template. For the nanny-share voucher, any co-parent verification needed?

Samir Nadeem: Usually partners require a household verification and shared schedule. We'll include partner enrollment steps in the DM. Voucher availability depends on region (US/CA/UK supported right now).

IT Security: FYI if you're using a shared caregiver to access any office passes or systems temporarily, file an access request. Otherwise no special IT steps for care vendors.

Riley Morgan: One more Q: are there adjustments to objectives/KPIs during phased return? I don't want to be penalized for reduced hours.

Manager - Carla: We'll rebaseline goals for the phased period and document expected outcomes. We'll track by outcomes not hourly. I'll add a short note to your goal doc and ask PMs to prorate deliverables.

Benefits Team: After intake we'll aim for voucher/enrollment within 7-10 business days. Phased-return paperwork processed in 5-7 business days after manager sign-off. For any expediting, tag @Benefits Team with "expedite".

Riley Morgan: Thanks all. Filing intake now, selecting voucher option and phased-return. Will post confirmation here and attach the weekly hours schedule. :pray:
